evidence_items.locator: section 'Google highlights an ARC-AGI-2 “verified” score of 77.1%'

receipt.public_excerpt: Google says Gemini 3.1 Pro achieved a verified score of 77.1% on ARC-AGI-2 and calls that “more than double” the reasoning performance of Gemini 3 Pro.

evidence_items.explanation: Shows strong and fast-improving reasoning on a hard novel-pattern benchmark. This cuts against calling reasoning problems 'serious', though it does not show the documented failures were gone.

unresolved_gaps: The Nguyen study tested models up to GPT-5 and Grok-4, not Gemini 3.x or Claude Opus 4.6, the frontier at the post date.
'Serious' has no threshold, so judging how much progress offsets the failures is subjective.
